t: You're at the tomb of Jane Clouson in Brockley Cemetery, where she is both buried and commemorated. She was found beaten with a hammer in the early hours of 26 April 1871 and died in hospital four days later. Edmund Pook was charged with her murder but found not guilty. The case is sometimes called the Eltham murder, and the killing, the police investigation and the prosecution drew considerable press attention. She was seventeen when she died.
